children: Canary Staked TRX ETF reported a decrease in net assets from operations of $84,273 since inception on September 8, driven by a $114,859 unrealized depreciation in TRX investments, partly offset by $76,103 in staking income; there are no comparable prior-year results.
: The Trust held 150,057,738 TRX valued at $50.7M at September 30.
: 134,822,341 TRX, worth $45.6M, was staked at September 30.
: 2.02M shares were created and none were redeemed from inception through September 30.
: TRX depreciated 0.22% from September 8 to September 30; NAV per share declined 0.16%.
